contributionMap.claim: Theorem 2.3: GHSW_p extends with no moment assumption to a metric on probability measures on the closed Klein ball, which is its compact completion; it metrises weak convergence and has exact diameter 2C_{d,p}^{1/p}.

limitationTriage.limitation: Minimax constants are not sharp (upper/lower ratio about 20-80).
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Two-point lower bound and Jensen upper bound; ratios computed and stated.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Results cover only the exact average over all directions with a fixed origin; finitely many directions never separate (Proposition 6.2).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What holds for data-dependent origins or other angular measures?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Stated as scope; Proposition 5.4 bounds random-projection error for fixed pairs.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Horospherical construction, general Cartan-Hadamard manifolds and sampling rates for the augmented metric are not treated.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do analogous completion and boundary results hold there?
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Numerical scripts could be silently disabled under python -O or accept a corrupted value.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail when an expected value is wrong, including under python -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All checks are explicit (no assert); a corrupted boundary identity (beta_2 = pi alpha changed to 1.01 pi alpha) makes verify_and_plot.py exit non-zero under -O (release gate negative control).

limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded search.
